allow: PowerShell(Get-PSDrive C | Select-Object Used, Free | ForEach-Object { "Used: {0:N1} GB  Free: {1:N1} GB" -f \($_.Used/1GB\), \($_.Free/1GB\) })

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\.gradle\\caches" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum | ForEach-Object { "Gradle cache size: {0:N1} GB" -f \($_.Sum/1GB\) }; \(Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\.gradle\\caches" -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum\).Sum / 1GB | ForEach-Object { "Total: {0:N1} GB" -f $_ })
